football_data_org.note: Free-plan coverage is limited. It supplements API-Football and browser discovery; it never replaces SofaScore/Flashscore or API-Football.

live_tennis_api.note: Especially useful as an independent Challenger singles discovery/gap source. Every candidate still requires canonical reconciliation, PIT history gates and physical dedup before MATRIX admission.

ranking_rule.current_rank: May be used only for a prospective event when captured before freeze and the model/domain explicitly permits that timestamp.
ranking_rule.historical_rank: May be used only when the source exposes an explicit historical date and the captured value can be tied to that date.
ranking_rule.retroactive_use: PROHIBITED. A rank visible today may not be injected into a freeze or historical feature cutoff from an earlier date.

football_statistics_rule.prospective_use: Allowed only when the statistic existed and was captured before the governed feature cutoff/freeze.
football_statistics_rule.reconciliation: If a paid API provides the same statistic, disagreement must be persisted and adjudicated under provider reconciliation; no silent overwrite.

provider_priority_rule.statement: SofaScore and Flashscore remain the mandatory first daily world-calendar baseline for BOTH football and tennis. Paid APIs remain mandatory primary structured acquisition sources. Verified free APIs football-data.org and Live Tennis API are mandatory auxiliary post-baseline crosschecks when available, used to detect omissions and add independent structured identity without replacing either browser sources or paid APIs.

daily_crosscheck_rule.rule: Every operational Bogota date must have physical SofaScore and Flashscore query evidence for both football and tennis before a source set may be treated as daily world discovery complete enough to feed governed candidate selection.
daily_crosscheck_rule.paid_api_role: Structured acquisition, IDs, timestamps, history, reproducible features, automation and SHA/provenance.
daily_crosscheck_rule.browser_role: Worldwide discovery, omission detection, calendar/identity validation and auxiliary PIT features.
daily_crosscheck_rule.free_api_role: Independent structured coverage/gap detection after the SofaScore/Flashscore baseline and alongside paid-API reconciliation. No free API is world truth.

calendar_first_operating_order.exact_count_rule: A numeric total may be labeled exact only when physically observed or machine-verified from that source. User-visible reports and lazy/partial accessibility enumerations must retain their provenance and may not be silently promoted to exact world totals.

football_data_org.reason: Free plan has limited competition coverage and is not world complete.

live_tennis_api.reason: Useful independent fixture/identity source; must prove incremental coverage and pass reconciliation before any model feature role.

operational_day_rule.canonical_membership_rule: An event belongs to the operational date determined by converting its authoritative scheduled start timestamp to America/Bogota. Provider calendar_date/event_date fields do not override the Bogota-local date.
operational_day_rule.utc_window_formula: For Bogota date D, include event_start_utc >= D 05:00:00Z and < (D+1) 05:00:00Z.
